Marta: Final tech smoke and failover script thread. Quick: we have one dry-run tomorrow 9:00am PT and the live webinar 2026-03-22 10:00am PT. Need confirmations on who does which live roles.
Sam: I'll own latency monitoring + canary flip. Will have a single CLI snippet ready to switch alias.
Devin: I'll run the demo and keep it to three 4-minute segments. If we hit time pressure we'll skip the deep dive and go to the customer Q&A.
Jia: Infra: staging model endpoints are warmed. I've created a `canary-flip` job that swaps the model alias to `demo-fallback` in 30s. Alert rule posted in the drive.
Alex: Stage ops: I'll handle spotlighting, recording, and chat messages. My short fallback message (ready to paste): "We're switching to a recorded demo for a better experience. Continue dropping questions and we'll answer live after the clip."
Marta: Perfect. Can we have a short poster link to the transcript ready (in case we paste text)?
Sam: Done. Transcript upload: https://drive.example.com/webinars/practical-inference/transcript.txt
Devin: Adding a quick canary command I'll hand to Sam for the flip: ```bash
# quick canary flip to fallback alias
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.staging/v1/aliases/swap \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"from":"demo-live","to":"demo-fallback"}'
```
Jia: Also added an automated policy: if staging P95 > 1.2s for 3 minutes, a webhook pings #stage-ops with suggested flip. We'll still require manual approval to flip.
Alex: Roles: Marta = host/chat lead, Sam = console/canary, Devin = demo, Jia = infra ops, Alex = stage ops. Are we good?
Marta: Yes. Quick timing: 0:00 intro (Marta) 5m, 5:00 benchmarks (Sam) 10m, 15:00 demo (Devin) 12m, 27:00 customer story + Q&A 28m. Keep strict pacing.
Sam: I'll post a timer link in the lobby doc and ping at 30s left for each segment.
Devin: Request: please mute attendee audio and spotlight me when I start the demo.
Alex: On it. Also testing spotlight hotkey in the rehearsal.
calendar-bot: Event "Practical Inference - Practical Latency & Cost" scheduled for 2026-03-22 10:00am PT https://cal.example.com/event/67890
Marta: Rehearsal schedule 9:00am PT tomorrow: 1) quick tech check 2) full run with chat on 3) fallback drill 4) timings review. Everyone confirm availability now?
Sam: Confirmed.
Devin: Confirmed.
Jia: Confirmed.
Alex: Confirmed.
Marta: Great. Upload any last-minute slides to /webinar/final_deck by EOD. Closing thread; ping #oncall if emergency.
